author: ARIA Home (synthetic)
description: Synthetic care_home_v1 scenario (all synthetic, 2026-01-16/17, America/New_York -05:00): an older adult lives alone in a modern single-storey house (demo-house); on a winter night the living area cools from about 70 F through the evening while the furnace is reported idle; readiness stays on track at 19:20 and 21:00; ARIA Home notices at 21:41, 2 F below the target, and asks the family caregiver at 22:46, 6 F below, well before the household warm-by time 07:00; the caregiver authorises a simulated HVAC request at 22:47; the thermostat stops reporting from 23:00 to 00:20, while an independent room sensor shows the decline; a technician is on site from 23:30 to 00:15 and a completion report follows (corroboration only); thermostat reporting returns (proves nothing alone); independent readings show warming from 00:15, reach 68 F at 01:10 and hold it, verified at 01:40. Sources: calendar, thermostat, room_sensor, electrical, weather, simulated events. Cadences: thermostat 300 s, room_sensor 300 s, electrical 1800 s, weather 21600 s. No health data, no medical terms, no location tracking of the person, no fall or activity sensing. Not a medical or emergency service.
scenario_period_note: Scenario timestamps (January 2026) are fictional replay times, not when the data was created. All data is synthetic; all actor and communication events are simulated. Sources: calendar, thermostat, room_sensor (its own source), electrical, weather. Cadences: thermostat 300 s, room_sensor 300 s, electrical 1800 s, weather 21600 s.
